adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, each item is processed with `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If a feed item has `content == nil`, this will raise `NoMethodError` on `nil.scrub` and abort the whole polling run. The code also passes `i.title` directly into `TopicEmbed.import(...)`, and that ultimately uses `PostCreator` with `skip_validations: true`, so a nil/blank title could lead to creating an invalid/blank-titled topic rather than being rejected. Since the job is scheduled hourly and has `sidekiq_options retry: false`, a single malformed item can reliably prevent successful processing on each run until the feed changes.
